I am a man of 41 years, here in Lilongwe, and my plot is very small — not even a full quarter hectare. Maize is our food, so I must do what I can. If I get the FISP coupon this year, I will buy the NPK and urea at the subsidy price, because without that help I cannot afford full-price fertilizer. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I spread what little manure I have, and I intercrop with groundnut or beans to help the soil. I will plant hybrid seed if the coupon gives it, otherwise I recycle seed from last year. The plot is small so my wife and I can manage it ourselves without hiring people.
